market_outlook.short_term: Volatile. Oil above $103 and hot US data keep rate-hike bets alive, pressuring bonds and gold. Nasdaq AI rally provides equity support but is vulnerable to any yield spike. Yen intervention at 160 could trigger FX volatility. US-China truce provides a floor through Q4.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive for equities if truce holds past Jan 2027. AI capex cycle (Broadcom, Nvidia, AMD) supports 12-18mo earnings growth. Energy transition (LNG, metals, space) offers structural tailwinds. Risk: truce collapse, persistent oil-driven inflation forcing prolonged tight policy.
